title: TrainingMetricsRow
description: Flat per-epoch training metrics, one row per epoch in metrics.csv. Column order is the contract (consumers read by header name, but plot/spreadsheet defaults assume this order). The CSV writes empty cells for non-finite values; the JSON representation of a row treats those as null. Schema describes one row. Validity rule: epoch / lr / train_loss / val_loss / epoch_seconds are always present and finite — if a producer writes them as null/empty, that's a producer bug worth surfacing. Validation metrics (val_auroc / val_accuracy / etc.) are legitimately nullable: AUROC is undefined on a single-class val split, ECE is undefined when no reliability bin contains samples, etc. Renamed from 'metrics' at egm-contracts v0.3.0 — parallel to TrainingRunRecord. Future per-activity metric tables would get their own schemas.

epoch.description: 1-based epoch number. Strictly increasing across the run.

lr.description: Learning rate at the epoch's last optimizer step. Required and finite — captures schedule behavior.

train_loss.description: Mean training-set loss across all batches in the epoch. Required and finite.

val_loss.description: Mean validation-set loss across all batches in the epoch. Required and finite. (Validation-set selection lives in the run config, not here.)

val_auroc.description: Validation AUROC for the positive class. Null when AUROC is undefined (e.g., a single-class val split, or zero positives).

val_accuracy.description: Validation accuracy at the configured decision threshold (typically 0.5). Null when the val set is empty.

val_precision.description: Validation precision = TP / (TP + FP). Null when TP + FP == 0 (no positives predicted).

val_recall.description: Validation recall = TP / (TP + FN). Null when TP + FN == 0 (no actual positives in val set).

val_f1.description: Validation F1 = harmonic mean of precision and recall. Null when either precision or recall is null.

val_ece.description: Expected Calibration Error: weighted average gap between predicted confidence and empirical accuracy across reliability bins. Lower is better-calibrated. Null when no reliability bin contains samples.

epoch_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds spent on this epoch (training + validation). Required.
